characters.continuity: DC Comics, Dark Nights: Metal (2017) and related Dark Multiverse tie-in issues
characters.summary: Bruce Wayne of Earth -32 who received a Green Lantern ring immediately following his parents' murder. Overwhelmed by his bottomless grief and sheer rage, he twisted the ring into a lethal instrument of darkness, slaughtering his world's criminals and eventually conquering his entire universe.

Lethal beams and energy projections bypassing Green Lantern restrictions
Power ring pushed past normal limits by his will, with the no-killing restriction overridden
Dark constructs described as stronger than his world's whole Green Lantern Corps
Murdered every Green Lantern and Guardian in his universe
Beat Hal Jordan and laid waste to Coast City

mechanisms: Advanced combat training combined with ring-generated resilience

weaknesses: Vulnerable to extreme emotional anomalies that disrupt his absolute focus
Deeply unhinged mental state
Raven nearly beat him by seizing control of his constructs
Defeated with the other Dark Knights by the Justice League

limitations: Requires willpower and intense focus, though distorted by corruption
